title: Asking the bot for a new project gets two replies at once, each quoting the whole question

Reply 2: 'That sounds like a new app of its own, so I'll come back to you here in a minute…'. Needs you also lists it under 'Only you' with 'Only you' again on the right.

title: New-project idea from Main Chat stalls: the bot opens a private 'New thread' but answers in Main, promises to 'come back in a minute', and never does
repro: As a member, Main Chat: 'Can you make us a chore chart for our flat? …'. Bot: 'New thread, for a new project: …' + 'That sounds like a new app of its own, so I'll come back to you here in a minute with how to get it started.' After 4+ min nothing; the new thread shows 'No replies yet'; server logs show no further bot work. Replying anything in the empty thread (e.g. 'Yes please') makes the bot draw version 1 there, so the flow only continues if the person thinks to prod it.
cause: start_project_thread (homeroom-bot-mayor.js C2.4) should route this turn's reply into the new thread (answer()); the reply landed in Main and the model promised a follow-up the system has no job for

title: A new-project thread is renamed to the person's latest reply ('Yes please. Just the three of us…'), in its header and its Needs you row
repro: Reply 'Yes please…' in a 'New thread, for a new project: A chore chart…' thread: its title and row become the reply text
cause: thread title derived from the latest user message instead of the idea/project name

title: The bot's drawn first screen uses made-up June dates ('Mon 9 – Sun 15 June · week 24') in November

cause: designer prompt has no today's date; invents sample dates

title: 'New project > A group' from the bot's drawn version 1 opens the generic create screen with the last chat line as the description, no name, and a fresh 20-30 min build

Leaving the thread before choosing also drops the 'Who is it for?' step.

title: A first version waiting on its creator's two answers is listed as 'Waiting · Nobody yet', not Needs you; the idea thread still offers 'New project' for the project just made

title: While a first version waits for its creator's answers, Main Chat says 'I'm setting up Flat Chores now… tell you here when it's live' over a row marked 'Stopped'

cause: activity row maps the plan-wait state to 'Stopped'; the setup message is sent before the plan is answered

title: A first version's plan cannot be reached once the create screen is left: every door loops between the Hub and Main Chat

cause: first-version activity rows and their threads are redirected to the project page; the Hub's Review link targets Main Chat instead of the plan message in the activity thread
